risk_reasons: An exported admin contract names authorization gates and must not understate their posture or response shapes.
goal: The Admin app developer can consume a portable generated Admin API contract whose source drift fails CI.
user_visible_behavior: Generate committed standalone declarations, request JSON schemas and a method-specific route table.
ci:admin-contract fails on drift, missing or stale route rows and unsupported provenance or wire forms.
invariants: Reuse the admin-aal2 resolver and handler inventory.
Derive wire types from actual JSON expressions through the compiler; no handwritten duplicate shapes.
Keep the barrel an index of existing DTOs.
Never evaluate runtime route/auth/DB modules to produce schemas.
Truthfully describe JSON serialization and existing error envelope exceptions.
Staging first, PR, then owner approval before merge.
edge_cases: Inline and composed response objects including #1189 batchSummary and betaCompActive.

Successful JSON projection preserves optional omissions, undefined array nulls, invalid-Date and non-finite-number nulls, and nested unknown JSON-value uncertainty; unresolved top-level any/unknown fails.
Call-site bindings retain response helper arguments, callback config and wrapped handlers; unresolved producers fail with route and source location.
Normalization and refinement metadata labels JSON Schema approximations; padded and whitespace-only keywords demonstrate disagreements.
Unrecognized export, response or schema dependency shapes fail with source location.
Hand-parsed multipart and bodyless requests have no invented schema.
Private module dependencies cannot leak into the standalone declaration artifact.
tests_to_add: reports canonical gate names for every exported method
emits portable wire declarations for composed responses and JSON serialization
generates request schemas without importing runtime modules
fails on edited declarations and missing or stale route rows
detects route method and gate provenance drift
rollback_plan: Revert the contract/tooling PR; it changes no runtime API, database or flag. Realign staging after any approved merge.
observability: Deterministic audit diffs identify artifact drift; generated README records route/method/gate/schema and response/status coverage.
